summary: Final regression passed: public marketplace APIs, 12 demo photographers, categories/services, registration masking, protected 401s, responsive homepage/search/profile, and unauthenticated favorite/chat/booking/dashboard/OAuth retry flows.

critical.issue: Invalid or failed OAuth session responses without an email field raise KeyError and return HTTP 500 instead of a controlled 401/4xx; backend log shows data["email"] failure.

action_items: Validate OAuth session response shape before accessing email and return a controlled 401 so failed OAuth never produces a backend 500; retain the existing frontend retry screen.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_session trusts external session JSON and directly indexes data['email']; malformed provider responses are an unhandled server exception.
seed_data_creation: Existing regression registration created TEST Fotografer records; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Unauthenticated and public flows are covered and passing. Positive OAuth/authenticated persistence remains unavailable without an external session. Payment remains intentionally DEFERRED/MOCKED. Existing pytest requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported because it does not load frontend/.env automatically.
rca of the issue: Reproduce by POSTing an invalid/expired session_id to /api/auth/session. The external provider returns JSON without email; server catches only request/json exceptions, then data['email'] raises KeyError, producing 500. Mitigate by validating provider status and required email before database access and raising HTTPException(401).
